name: Obsidian Starter Kit

variants.name: Essentials
variants.description: The complete vault, the online user guide and every future update

contents: **My own Obsidian vault**, packaged for you: structure, note types, templates, Bases, plugins, automation rules and an AI assistant system, all configured and documented
**Clearly defined note types** with structured properties, statuses and automation rules, managed by the OSK plugin, its CLI (`osk-cli`) and its `MCP` server
**A template for every kind of note**: it fills in the metadata and files the note where it belongs

**Finished work that files itself**: statuses stamp their dates, and done goals, plans, projects, tasks, activities and ideas move to the archive seven days later (change the delay or switch it off per note type)
**Quick Actions**: rows of buttons and one-click captures on your daily note, plus a side panel with every button
**A complete action system**: goals, plans, projects, tasks, activities and ideas linked across the hierarchy, with dependencies, Kanban boards and time budgets
**An ideal week for your activities**: a week grid with no dates on the `Kanban: Activities` board, where every active activity gets its recurring time blocks next to its weekly target
**A journaling system** with daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly and yearly notes that share one shape, powered by the `Journal Bases` plugin, plus a session note for each workout, practice or game
**Activity time that counts itself**: each session note holds its minutes, and your activities and weekly time budgets take their time from those notes
**A knowledge workflow** that takes you from capture and literature notes to permanent notes
**People and meeting systems** with interaction tracking, decisions and actions

**A Media Management System**: one note per movie, TV show, anime, manga, comic, video game, board game or album, with status, ownership, loans, pledges, ratings and covers, Bases and Kanban boards for each medium, and a Year in Media. Your books get the same ownership, wishlist and loan properties

**A Music Learning System**: guitar and piano chords, scales, techniques, exercises and songs, each with a mastery level, plus spaced review, a skill tree and the `Music Practice` plugin (practice timer, metronome, playable notation)

**Health and habit tracking** (mood, energy, sleep, nutrition) with the `Life Tracker` plugin; workouts become session notes (from Garmin, a Strava export or by hand), with reports on your training load and progress

First-class `Obsidian Bases` support: database-like views for books, projects, contacts, media, time budgets and more, including Kanban boards that open fast with thousands of cards and work on your phone
**Lists that survive renames**: the queries behind your lists follow the notes you rename, and validation flags links to a missing note or to the wrong kind of note

**An AI assistant system**: agents with memory, AI skills (including skills for your creations and skills that change your QuickAdd, Meta Bind, Dataview Serializer and Templater settings without touching your own), panels, LLM Wikis and a Personal Identity System. `Claude Code` gets all of it; `Codex`, `Gemini CLI` and `GitHub Copilot` get part of it
**MCP servers pre-wired** for `Claude Code` and `Codex`, and a Claude Code setup that finds skills on demand instead of loading all of them up front
**Bundles for chat AIs**: one command puts the notes you pick (a folder, a note type, a tag or a Map of Content) into a single file for a Claude project, Gemini or Gemini Notebook
**Pre-configured plugins and settings**, including `Kanban Action Planner`, `K-Plex`, the `Knowii Community` plugin and `Time Machine` (so you can recover lost work)
The OSK plugin in **English or French** (it follows Obsidian's language), and `osk-cli` for Windows, macOS and Linux
**Visual thinking support** with Canvas and Excalidraw
**An online user guide**: foundations, systems, theory, step-by-step tutorials, reference docs and migration guides
**The Obsidian Starter Course**, a video course of over two hours (Premium edition)
